title: Wesley's Moons Wiki/about
html:
About

Moons
  • Wesley's Moons is a collection of 52 moons with a roguelike system built in made by Magic_Wesley for the indie title Lethal Company. All the moons have unique ideas and concepts behind them; with each moon you explore having varying challenges to face, and areas to explore!
  • The new roguelike system will have you unlock new moons through a simple progression system that'll take you on a couple journeys through a collection of moons.
  • Moons can have unique hazards that can be seen on exterior or within the interior.
Interiors
  • There is also Wesley's Interiors which currently adds 13 unique interiors.
  • Most interiors have their own hazards and some of them even events which you can trigger.
  • There are also interiors with special mechanics which will make your gameplay more untypical.
Items
  • Wesley's Moons features 500+ items which are:
    • Wesley's Scrap
    • Loggable items
    • Videotapes
    • Ingredient items
    • Key items
    • Reward items
    • Action fiugres
    • Destiny items
    • Unused items
